rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for criticism that is harsh, bitter, and cutting.

example.english: His review of that new film was so scathing that it made people uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 佢對嗰套新戲嘅評論尖酸刻薄得滯，睇到人都唔舒服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 go2 tou3 san1 hei3 ge3 ping4 leon6 zim1 syun1 hak1 bok6 dak1 zai6 tai2 dou2 jan4 dou1 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this especially for a person or comment that attacks others with deliberately sharp, hurtful language.

example.english: Don't be so scathing; Ming only said one thing wrong.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁毒舌，阿明只係講錯一句啫。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 duk6 sit3 aa3 ming4 zi2 hai6 gong2 co3 jat1 geoi3 ze1
